The profile modal pre-ticks "Autofill from LinkedIn & save time", which would import personal details. Untick it if you do not want that.
It is a professional network, so the launch hangs off a real profile with your name and bio on it. Whatever identity you sign up with becomes the public face of the launch.
Everything is bot-protected and returns 403 to non-browser requests, so an HTTP probe makes the site look dead when it is not.
